messages:
Noah Patel: FYI - Aurora Capital (acct AC-212) hasn't paid INV-2026-078 for $42,300. Received an email from their finance lead asking to split over three months and asking for a $5k adjustment due to suspected meter double-counting on 2025-11-02. Tagging CS and billing.
Lina Gomez: I pulled the account. No prior payment plans. They were on net30 and past due by 18 days. No open disputes in Zendesk except this new ticket #TKT-5079 from yesterday.
Eli - CS: Customer reached out via phone. They said a scheduled job retried several times and may have caused duplicate usage records. Sent us logs. They're asking to keep services online if possible while plan is arranged.
Priya Shah: Collections policy: we can approve payment plans up to 90 days if initial payment is >= 30%. Credit approvals: managers can approve <= $2,500, anything above needs legal. Also no SLA changes without exec sign-off.
Noah Patel: Customer asked for 3-way 0/50/50 (defer initial) — not acceptable. Propose 40% now, 30% in 30 days, 30% in 60 days. That would be $16,920 now. Also they requested waiver of late fees and reversal of the alleged double-bill for $5,000.
Lina Gomez: If we credit $5k, remaining balance would be $37,300 and schedule recalculated. We should ask engineering to validate the duplicate-billing claim before committing credit.
eng-alerts: Engineering note: saw the job in logs (job ID masked) with 3 retries due to transient 504 from partner endpoint on 2025-11-02. Retried job submission used identical request id but our ingestion dedupe flag didn't fire because the request id field was missing in one of the retries. Root cause tracked in ENG-3124.
Eli - CS: Customer provided the exact job payloads. They marked one retry as accidental. They want full $5k back. They're small but strategic.
Noah Patel: Per Priya, anything > $2,500 needs legal. Sam (Legal) - can you weigh in if a $5k credit is OK for retention and risk?
Sam (Legal): Quick read: no legal objection to the credit itself, but require a credit memo with "credit contingent on executed payment agreement" and a final acceptance of corrected ingestion behavior (bug fix timeline) to protect us from repeat claims. Also recommend limiting to one-time goodwill credit and documenting root cause.
Priya Shah: Given that, I'll approve up to $2,500 unilaterally. If you want $5k we need exec/legal sign-off. Also suggest we require ACH or wire for initial 40% and hold any suspension until 2026-01-10 as a courtesy if initial payment posts.
Noah Patel: Customer asked for 45-day no-suspension window. We can do conditional hold until 2026-01-10 if 40% posts by 2025-12-05 and DocuSign returned within 72 hours.
Lina Gomez: Collections-bot: sending dunning #2 now at 1960002200. I've paused auto-suspend for 48 hours while we negotiate.
collections-bot: Dunning notice sent: payment reminder. Suspension timer paused for 48h per manual override.
Noah Patel: I'll offer the customer: 40/30/30 schedule, $2,500 goodwill credit (to be revisited after eng confirms root cause), no late fee this cycle, conditional hold until 2026-01-10 pending initial payment and signed agreement. If they insist on $5k, escalate to Legal for sign-off and exec approval.
Eli - CS: Customer verbally accepted the 40/30/30 + $2,500 credit and will sign. They asked to keep internal job IDs out of invoice line items. Said they'd wire the initial 40% on 2025-12-04.
Priya Shah: Good. Please ensure DocuSign has clause: "Credit contingent on execution of payment plan agreement and acknowledgment of root cause remediation timeline." Sam, please review DocuSign text when it's ready.
Sam (Legal): I'll review. If they request additional concessions, ping me.
Lina Gomez: Preparing INV-2026-078-A with adjusted balance after $2,500 credit: new total $39,800. Schedule: 40% ($15,920) due 2025-12-04, 30% ($11,940) due 2026-01-03, 30% ($11,940) due 2026-02-02. DocuSign to customer at 1960003200.
collections-bot: DocuSign sent -> viewed at 1960003300. Reminder scheduled: initial-payment-reminder on 2025-12-03.
Eli - CS: Customer viewed and asked for a small invoice wording tweak to redact an internal job id. Lina, can billing sanitize?
Lina Gomez: Yes, we'll redact job ids. Also added account note: "Payment plan approved (conditional). Do not suspend until 2026-01-10 if 40% clears by 2025-12-05."
Noah Patel: Confirm: if initial payment fails or DocuSign not returned by 72h, we resume suspension immediately and escalate to Legal.
Priya Shah: Correct. Collections-bot, please set verification reminder for 2025-12-06 to validate payment posting.
collections-bot: Reminder set: verify-initial-payment on 2025-12-06.
eng-alerts: Patch for ingest dedupe behavior scheduled for 2025-11-20; monitoring to ensure no recurrence.
Eli - CS: I'll keep the customer regularly updated and ask them to confirm wire reference.
Lina Gomez: I'll mark this as "conditional hold" in the collections dashboard and log credit memo pending.
Noah Patel: Thanks everyone. If the customer later asks for the extra $2,500 (to reach $5k), route to Sam and VP Finance. For now proceed with the $2,500 credit and the staged payment plan.
collections-bot: If payment not received by 2025-12-06, escalate to collections-team and resume suspension timer.
